description_en: Queries the configuration of proactive defense switches
description_zh: 查询主动防御开关配置信息
name: DescribeSuspiciousOverallConfig

parameters.help_en:
The switch type. Valid values:

auto_breaking: Anti-virus.
ransomware_breaking: Anti-ransomware (decoy capture).
webshell_cloud_breaking: Web shell connection defense.
alinet: Malicious network behavior defense.
k8s_log_analysis: Container K8s threat detection.
alisecguard: Client self-protection defense mode
parameters.help_zh:
开关类型。取值：

auto_breaking：防病毒
ransomware_breaking：防勒索（诱饵捕获）
webshell_cloud_breaking：网站后门连接防御
alinet：恶意网络行为防御
k8s_log_analysis：容器K8s威胁检测
alisecguard：客户端自保护防御模式
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the member accounts in the resource folder (Alibaba Cloud account).
You can invoke the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号ID（阿里云账号）。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

off: Disabled.
